text: New Era (New Era Cap) is a family-owned company in its fourth generation of Koch family leadership, run by chief executive Christopher H. Koch; it was founded by Ehrhardt Koch in 1920.
short: New Era Cap is a family-owned company led by fourth-generation CEO Christopher H. Koch.

source.name: Jackie Robinson Foundation: Christopher Koch (board member profile)
source.quote: Christopher H. Koch is the fourth generation CEO of the family-owned company New Era.
source.note: Undated page; opened 2026-10-03. The 1920 founding by Ehrhardt Koch and the family succession are on the archived copy of New Era's own history page cited below; the live page rate-limits scripted clients (HTTP 429).
